senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Tulbaḳné, on the upper Euphrates (v. S. Funk Juden in Babyl., p. 13, note 2).
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 71b:15">Kidd. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>עד אקרא דת׳</he> Babylonia extends (for genealogical purposes) as far as Fort (the fortified ford of) T.
<cite ref="Megillah 6a:10">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אקרא דת׳</he> (Ms. F. <he>עקרא דתולבנקי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 100); <cite ref="Ketubot 112a">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ דתולבנקי</he>.—
Gen. R. s. 16 עד מקום … ואיזו זו תִּרְבַּקְנָה as far (east) as where the Euphrates runs, there is the land of Israel; and what place is this? It is Tirbaḳnah (?).
